ORDINANCE LVIII OF 2001
ORDINANCE LVIII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
WILDLIFE PROTECTION
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan
Wildlife Protection
Act, 1974
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
22nd January, 2002]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑V,
dated 22‑1‑2002. The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 28th December, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Balochistan Wildlife Protection (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th day of August, 2001.

Amendment of section 32 of Act XIX of 1974

Balochistan on 28th December, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 32 of
Act XIX of 1974.‑‑‑In the Balochistan Wildlife Protection
Act, 1974, in section 32, for the words "District Magistrate or any"
the word "Any" shall be substituted.
